data.name: Privacy.Disclaimer
data.value: This is a draft reflecting how Tessera actually works today. It hasn't been reviewed by a lawyer — replace the placeholders below and get professional review before opening the service beyond your own household.

data.name: Privacy.IntroBody
data.value: Tessera is operated by [operator name — placeholder], contactable at [privacy@example.com — placeholder]. This policy explains what data we process when you use the Tessera bot and console, and why.

data.name: Privacy.DataProfile
data.value: Account data — email and display name, to run your account.

data.name: Privacy.DataChannel
data.value: Channel identity — your Telegram chat ID, to deliver messages to the right chat.

data.name: Privacy.DataContent
data.value: Content you create — shopping list items, expenses, reminders and the spaces you share them in, to provide the service.

data.name: Privacy.DataMessages
data.value: Message text — sent to Azure OpenAI to interpret natural-language requests; not stored beyond what's needed to reply.

data.name: Privacy.DataCalendar
data.value: Calendar events (once calendar integration ships) — read at the moment they're needed and not stored.

data.name: Privacy.DataTokens
data.value: OAuth tokens (once calendar integration ships) — kept encrypted in Azure Key Vault, never in the database, only with your explicit consent for that integration.

data.name: Privacy.LegalBasisBody
data.value: Account, channel and content data are processed to perform the service you asked for. Optional integrations (calendar, and anything similar in the future) are processed only with your separate, explicit consent.

data.name: Privacy.LocationBody
data.value: All data is hosted on Microsoft Azure infrastructure in the EU (West Europe / North Europe regions).

data.name: Privacy.SharedSpacesBody
data.value: Anything you add to a space shared with other people — a shopping list item, an expense, a reminder — is visible to every member of that space, including after you leave it or delete your account. Deleting your account removes your name and every way of identifying you, but the content itself stays so the other members' shared history and totals stay correct. Free text you wrote (a note on an expense, the wording of a list item) can still contain personal details this doesn't touch — you can delete that content yourself before closing your account.

data.name: Privacy.RightsAccess
data.value: Access — download a copy of your data as JSON from the console at any time.

data.name: Privacy.RightsErasure
data.value: Erasure — delete your account from the console. Your personal space and everything in it is removed outright; your membership in shared spaces is pseudonymized as described above.

data.name: Privacy.RightsRectification
data.value: Rectification — update your profile, language and time zone from the console.

data.name: Privacy.SubprocessorsBody
data.value: Microsoft Azure (hosting, database, secrets storage) and Azure OpenAI (interpreting your messages) process data on our behalf under their own data-processing terms. Telegram, as the messaging platform, sees the messages you send it — that's between you and Telegram, governed by their own privacy policy.

data.name: Privacy.CookiesBody
data.value: The console sets one cookie to keep you signed in. It's required for the console to work and isn't used for tracking or analytics.

data.name: Privacy.ChangesBody
data.value: If this policy changes materially, we'll let you know before the change takes effect.

data.name: Privacy.ContactBody
data.value: Questions about this policy or your data: [privacy@example.com — placeholder].
